solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

indicators.note: in places the king's letter within the reworked letters
mixed signals that the letters of doubles are jumbled

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for king, from Latin rex

explanation.surface: A tennis match report: a royal player takes part in a mixed doubles game.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' rearranges DOUBLES into BOULDES, and 'in' puts R inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Boulders are large stones, so rocks is a plain synonym in the plural.

clue.text: Gambles without hesitation in capital investments

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside, so the wagers surround the pause

parts.note: gambles as a noun are bets
er is the sound of someone hesitating

explanation.surface: A speculator places bets on capital investments without pausing to think.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is the old sense of outside, not lacking. 'Capital' means head, so these investments are things put on the head.
explanation.definitionFit: Capital means head, and a beret is headwear one invests in, a playful crossword-only sense.

definitions.meaning: weather that is not fine is changeable or ...
an outstanding bill is one still unpaid, not yet settled

explanation.definitionFit: Unsettled weather is not fine, and an unsettled debt is still outstanding.

indicators.note: rising in a down clue means the word is read upwards, backwards

parts.note: a lord is a nobleman
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A peer's age is given as fifty-something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rising' reads the nobleman upwards in this down entry. 'fifty-odd' looks like an age but splits into the numeral and the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Droll means amusingly strange or quaint, so odd is a close synonym.

clue.text: Jumping the gun will mean starter will be upset

definitions.text: Jumping the gun will mean starter will be upset

indicators.note: upset signals that the letters of starter will be thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: At a race, a false start means the official who starts it will be annoyed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'will be upset' rearranges STARTER. Read whole, the clue says a false start means a race must begin again.
explanation.definitionFit: When a runner jumps the gun, the race has to begin again, which is a restart.

definitions.meaning: to wrap up snugly, as in a scarf
to deaden or soften a sound

explanation.surface: Advice for winter: stay snug and keep your voice down.
explanation.definitionFit: To muffle is both to wrap up warmly and to deaden sound.

parts.note: sounds like pulling out of a legal case, but means drawing a sword from its scabbard

explanation.definitionFit: To unsheathe a blade is to draw it out of its scabbard, its case.

clue.text: In truth, a point of view

indicators.note: In puts the compass point inside the word for truth

parts.note: a fact is a truth
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: Someone concedes that a remark is, in truth, just one perspective.
explanation.walkthrough: 'point of view' reads as one phrase, but 'a point' gives E and 'view' alone is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A facet is one aspect or side of a matter, a particular view of it.

parts.note: dispiriting looks like depressing, but means driving out spirits

explanation.definitionFit: An exorcist's job is casting out evil spirits from people or places.

clue.text: Improperly press one for an answer

indicators.note: improperly arranged, so these letters are put in another order

explanation.surface: A journalist badgers someone to get a reply.
explanation.definitionFit: A response is a reply, a direct synonym for answer.

clue.text: Shy cop to pull out of Hitchcock thriller

indicators.note: to pull the film title out of these letters by rearranging them

explanation.surface: A timid policeman wants to back out of a scary film.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to pull out of' signals rearranging SHY and COP together.
explanation.definitionFit: Psycho is the 1960 Alfred Hitchcock film about the Bates Motel.

definitions.meaning: a boss is a raised knob, and a ... is such an ornamental fastening

explanation.definitionFit: A stud is a macho man and also a knob or stud on a surface.

definitions.meaning: unqualified in the sense of complete, absolute

explanation.surface: Someone lacking credentials is asked to summarise.
explanation.definitionFit: Total means complete and unreserved, and to total is to add up.

clue.text: Teach unit members to become reliable

indicators.note: the members, the letters of teach unit, are rearranged to become the answer

explanation.surface: Instructing members of a unit so that they can be relied on.
explanation.walkthrough: 'members to become' rearranges the letters of TEACH and UNIT.
explanation.definitionFit: Something authentic is genuine and trustworthy, so reliable is a fair sense.

clue.text: In factory one is easily modified

indicators.note: In places the numeral inside the word for a works

parts.note: a plant is an industrial works
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: At a works, one product can be adapted readily.
explanation.definitionFit: Pliant means flexible and adaptable, easily bent or changed.

indicators.note: play signals the letters of enter game being moved about

explanation.surface: A sports star joins the team and signs a deal.
explanation.definitionFit: A contract is a formal agreement between parties.

definitions.meaning: to ditch is to discard or abandon
a pilot ... an aircraft by bringing it down on water

explanation.surface: A pilot gives up and brings the plane down on water.
explanation.definitionFit: Ditch means discard, and also to make a forced landing on the sea.

definitions.meaning: to hand something down is to pass it to the next generation

explanation.definitionFit: Hands down is an idiom for without effort, and hands down also means bequeaths.

clue.text: Due legal process in making a French leader

indicators.note: process signals that due legal is processed into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Proper legal procedure in creating a leader of France.
explanation.walkthrough: 'due legal process' is a stock phrase, but 'process' is the anagram signal on DUE and LEGAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles de Gaulle led Free France and later became President of France.

parts.note: to complete is to end

indicators.note: treatment of means the letters of sore are worked over into another order

explanation.surface: Finishing a course of treatment for a sore back.
explanation.walkthrough: 'treatment of' gives ORSE. 'back' looks like the body part, but is the verb meaning support.
explanation.definitionFit: To back someone is to support them, which is what endorsing means.

parts.note: Eve was Adam's partner, the first wife in Genesis

explanation.surface: The first officer on a ship is always correct.
explanation.walkthrough: 'First mate' suggests a ship's officer, but means Eve, the first woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Ever means at all times, a straightforward synonym for always.

indicators.note: roamed suggests wandering, so the letters of as once wander into a new order

explanation.surface: Seas that people sailed across long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Oceans are the great bodies of salt water, a near synonym for seas.

clue.text: Old and bald eccentric? Could be

indicators.note: could be signals that old and bald might become something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a bald old man is a bit strange.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Could be' rearranges OLD and BALD together.
explanation.definitionFit: An oddball is a strange or unconventional person, an eccentric.

clue.text: In panic, a hundred became hard to find

indicators.note: In puts the Roman hundred inside the word for alarm

parts.note: a scare is a sudden panic
C is the Roman numeral for a hundred

explanation.surface: In a panic, a hundred items vanished from the shelves.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarce means in short supply, so hard to find is a fair gloss.

definitions.meaning: to suspect or fear, as in to anticipate with dread

explanation.surface: Police hold someone they think guilty.
explanation.definitionFit: Apprehend means arrest, and also to be apprehensive about something.

parts.note: p, piano, is the musical direction for softly
to lug is to drag or haul

explanation.surface: Someone gently draws out the corks.
explanation.definitionFit: Plugs are bungs that seal an opening, which is what stoppers do.

parts.note: BA, Bachelor of Arts, is a university degree
sic is Latin for thus, used to mark a quoted error

explanation.surface: A university qualification seen as indispensable.
explanation.definitionFit: Basic means fundamental, so essential is a near synonym.

clue.text: Break arranged for one who works in a hot place

definitions.text: one who works in a hot place

indicators.note: arranged means the letters of break are set in another order

explanation.surface: A rota fixes a rest period for a worker in a sweltering job.
explanation.definitionFit: A baker works at an oven, which is a hot place.

clue.text: Shrub generally known not to be hardy

definitions.text: generally known not to be hardy
definitions.meaning: Stan ... is famously not Oliver Hardy, his comedy partner

explanation.definitionFit: Laurel is an evergreen bush, and Stan Laurel was the partner of Oliver Hardy.

clue.text: Not usually the best of the entries

definitions.text: Not usually the best of the entries

parts.words: Not usually the best of the entries
parts.note: entries suggests competition entrants, but means ways into a house; the rear one is seldom the best

explanation.definitionFit: A back door is an entrance to a building, usually less grand than the front.

clue.text: Tears out the last letter, it's fake

indicators.note: out means the letters of tears are put out of order

parts.note: Z is the last letter of the alphabet

explanation.surface: Someone rips out a final letter and declares it a forgery.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' gives ERSAT; 'the last letter' means the end of the alphabet, not of any word in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: Ersatz means an inferior imitation or substitute, so fake fits.

definitions.meaning: ... Nightingale was the pioneering Crimean War nurse
the capital city of the Tuscany region of Italy

explanation.surface: A songbird heard in the Italian countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: The nurse's first name was Florence, and Florence is the Tuscan capital.
